events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away 35 years ago today. He would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Tribute to a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost one of music's most electrifying performers. The showman, the voice, the legend. Still sorely missed, never forgotten.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Classic Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly changed the game. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon. He would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the music world lost a visionary. Remembering John Lennon, whose legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie Would Have Been 80
events.blurb: Remembering David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. Forever pushing boundaries, forever an icon. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley Would Have Been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves and inspiring artists worldwide.

events.title: Jimmy Page Turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist, songwriter, and producer, Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Guitar God Turns 83
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young for the architect of sound, Jimmy Page. Still influencing every riff and solo you hear.

events.title: Rod Stewart Turns 82
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart.

angles.name: Maggie May's Man Turns 82
angles.copy: Still rocking and still looking good! Happy 82nd to the one and only Rod Stewart. What's your favourite Rod tune?

events.title: Suggs Turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs (Graham McPherson), the charismatic frontman of Madness.

angles.name: It Must Be Love
angles.copy: Sixty-six years young for the one and only Suggs! Still bringing the house down with Madness. What's your favourite lyric?

events.title: Paul Young Turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a happy 71st birthday to the voice behind hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', Paul Young.

angles.name: Paul Young's 71st
angles.copy: Seventy-one today! The smooth vocals of Paul Young still sound as good as ever. What's your go-to Paul Young track?

events.title: Dolly Parton Turns 81
events.blurb: Happy 81st birthday to the legendary singer, songwriter, and icon, Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Queen of Country Turns 81
angles.copy: Eighty-one and still shining like a rhinestone cowboy! Happy birthday to the incredible Dolly Parton. What a woman!

events.title: Gary Barlow Turns 56
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman and songwriter, Gary Barlow.

angles.name: Gary Barlow's 56th
angles.copy: Fifty-six today! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting legend, Gary Barlow continues to entertain. What's your favourite Take That hit?

events.title: Billy Ocean Turns 77
events.blurb: Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic British soul singer, Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Get Outta My Dreams
angles.copy: Seventy-seven today! Still 'Caribbean Queen' in our hearts. Wishing a very happy birthday to Billy Ocean!

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's First Induction (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock royalty officially got their crowns. Who do you think should be inducted next?

events.title: Mark Owen Turns 55
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen.

angles.name: Mark Owen's 55th
angles.copy: Fifty-five today! The boyband charm is still very much intact. Happy birthday to Mark Owen!

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockers
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the rooftop for that legendary final gig. A moment in music history.

events.title: Phil Collins Turns 76
events.blurb: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary drummer, singer, and songwriter, Phil Collins.

angles.name: Phil's 76th
angles.copy: Seventy-six today! From Genesis to solo superstardom, Phil Collins has given us countless classics. What's your favourite?

events.title: Hugh Grant Turns 67
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to the charming British actor, Hugh Grant.

angles.name: Hugh's 67th
angles.copy: Still the king of rom-coms and now a brilliant character actor. Happy 67th to the one and only Hugh Grant!

events.title: Justin Timberlake Turns 46
events.blurb: Happy 46th birthday to pop superstar, Justin Timberlake.

angles.name: JT Turns 46
angles.copy: Forty-six today for the man who brought sexy back! Happy birthday, Justin Timberlake. What's your favourite solo hit?

events.title: David Jason Turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to national treasure, Sir David Jason.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Eighty-seven today for the legend that is Sir David Jason! Still making us laugh and smile. Lovely jubbly!

events.title: The Day The Music Died (1959)
events.blurb: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, who tragically died in a plane crash on this day in 1959.

angles.name: A Tragic Day
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years since 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering three incredible talents taken far too soon.

events.title: Rick Astley Turns 61
events.blurb: Happy 61st birthday to the iconic British singer, Rick Astley.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Sixty-one today! Still never gonna give you up, never gonna let you down. Happy birthday, Rick Astley!

events.title: Bob Marley Would Have Been 82
events.blurb: Remembering the reggae legend, Bob Marley, who would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love, One Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-two today for the king of reggae. Bob Marley's message of peace and unity still resonates.

events.title: Carole King Turns 85
events.blurb: Happy 85th birthday to the legendary singer-songwriter Carole King.

angles.name: Tapestry of Talent
angles.copy: Eighty-five years young! The woman behind countless hits, both for herself and others. Happy birthday, Carole King!

events.title: Whitney Houston: 15 Years Since Her Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston, who passed away 15 years ago today. She would have been 64 years old.

angles.name: Remembering The Voice
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost one of the greatest voices of all time. Whitney Houston, forever missed.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day, 31 years ago, Take That announced their initial split, breaking millions of hearts across the UK.

angles.name: Hearts Broken, Then Healed
angles.copy: Thirty-one years ago, the pop world wept as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they came back stronger!

events.title: Ali Campbell Turns 68
events.blurb: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40.

angles.name: Red, Red Wine & 68
angles.copy: Sixty-eight today for the man who gave us 'Red, Red Wine'. Happy birthday, Ali Campbell!

events.title: Ed Sheeran Turns 36
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to global superstar Ed Sheeran.

angles.name: Ed's 36th
angles.copy: Thirty-six today! From busking to selling out stadiums, Ed Sheeran continues to dominate the charts. Happy birthday!

events.title: George Harrison Would Have Been 84
events.blurb: Remembering 'the quiet Beatle', George Harrison, who would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering George
angles.copy: Eighty-four today for George Harrison. His timeless songs still bring us joy. What's your favourite Harrison track?

events.title: Roger Daltrey Turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to Roger Daltrey, the iconic frontman of The Who.

angles.name: Who's 83 Today?
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young for the legendary voice of The Who! Still a force of nature. Happy birthday, Roger Daltrey!

events.title: Nik Kershaw Turns 69
events.blurb: Wishing a happy 69th birthday to the talented 80s singer-songwriter, Nik Kershaw.

angles.name: Wouldn't It Be Good?
angles.copy: Sixty-nine today for the man who gave us 'The Riddle' and 'Wouldn't It Be Good'. Happy birthday, Nik Kershaw!

events.title: Chris Martin Turns 50
events.blurb: Happy 50th birthday to Coldplay frontman, Chris Martin.

angles.name: Half Century for Chris
angles.copy: Fifty years young for the voice of Coldplay! Still filling stadiums and writing anthems. Happy birthday, Chris Martin!

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi Turns 65
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 65th birthday to rock icon Jon Bon Jovi.

angles.name: Livin' on a Prayer at 65
angles.copy: Sixty-five today for the legendary frontman! Still rockin' and still got it. Happy birthday, Jon Bon Jovi!
